Colors of the Moon (NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day)

What color is the Moon? It depends on the night – and the time. Outside of the Earth's atmosphere, the dark Moon, which shines by reflected sunlight, appears a magnificently brown-tinged gray.

Source: NASA APOD (1 Nov 2026).
https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-1-colors-of-the-moon/

The featured image highlights a collection of apparent colors of the full moon on Earth, documented by one astrophotographer over 10 years from different locations across Italy. A red- or yellow-colored moon usually indicates a moon seen near the horizon.

Image: Marcella Giulia Pace.
